description: Show a maker page’s settings: their address keys and starting values, which typed list it takes, and the friendlier make_* tool when there is one. Use it before make_printable for makers without their own tool (calendars, planners, logs, graphic organizers, name tags, tickets and coupons, games, bubble letters and banners, graph and lined paper, multiplication and hundreds charts, number lines, sight words, color by number…).

page.description: The page, e.g. /graph-paper/ or /weekly-planner/ (find_printables gives paths).
